fields.objection: CHECK-029 demonstrates ellipticity loss in the inherited 0.01/0.005-MPa in-plane StVK core. Final conditional boundaries use an explicit 1/0.5-MPa regularization with an own sufficient local ellipticity check; these in-plane moduli are not measured core properties.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure the actual curved core and bond, include nonlinear core laws and disbond sensitivities; use the 038 grounding tests.
